result.summary: The street features a well-maintained pedestrian environment with wide sidewalks and a marked crosswalk at the intersection. However, the lack of physical buffers from traffic and absence of traffic calming measures are notable omissions in an otherwise walkable urban setting.

hazards.name: Degraded road surface
hazards.description: Visible cracking and uneven pavement in the roadway may pose a risk to pedestrians crossing the street.

hazards.name: Lack of traffic calming
hazards.description: The straight, wide roadway lacks physical measures to slow vehicle speeds, potentially increasing risk at the uncontrolled crossing.
hazards.location_in_image: Roadway stretch extending into the distance

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install curb extensions to shorten the crossing distance and improve visibility between pedestrians and drivers.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Repaint the crosswalk with high-visibility ladder or continental markings to improve driver awareness.

interventions.title: Pedestrian-Scale Lighting
interventions.description: Add lower-level lighting specifically for the sidewalk to improve visibility and security at night.

result.summary: The image shows a well-maintained residential street corner with wide sidewalks and historic brick buildings. Pedestrian infrastructure includes a marked crosswalk and a curb ramp, though the intersection lacks signals or advanced traffic calming features.

hazards.name: Metal Grate
hazards.description: A large metal utility grate is located directly in the pedestrian path at the corner, which can be slippery or a trip hazard.
hazards.location_in_image: On the sidewalk near the corner curb.

hazards.name: Low Tree Fence
hazards.description: A low metal fence surrounding the tree pit could be a tripping hazard for pedestrians, especially in low light.
hazards.location_in_image: Around the base of the tree on the sidewalk.

interventions.title: Curb Extension
interventions.description: Install a curb extension (bulb-out) to reduce the crossing distance and improve visibility between pedestrians and drivers.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalk
interventions.description: Upgrade the standard parallel line crosswalk to a high-visibility continental pattern.

interventions.title: Slip-Resistant Grate Covers
interventions.description: Ensure utility grates are slip-resistant and flush with the surrounding pavement to prevent falls.

result.summary: The image shows a narrow urban residential street with continuous sidewalks and a marked zebra crosswalk. The street geometry is relatively narrow, which helps manage vehicle speeds, though parked cars create potential sightline obstructions at the crossing point.

hazards.name: Visual obstruction from parked cars
hazards.description: Parked vehicles on the right side of the street near the crosswalk block the sightlines between pedestrians and approaching drivers.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the roadway, adjacent to the crosswalk

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install curb extensions (bulb-outs) at the intersection to shorten the pedestrian crossing distance and improve visibility by moving pedestrians into the driver's line of sight.

interventions.title: Intersection Daylighting
interventions.description: Remove the parking spaces immediately adjacent to the crosswalk to ensure clear sightlines for both pedestrians and motorists.

result.summary: A dense residential street with multi-story brick row houses and wide concrete sidewalks. The environment features a marked crosswalk and street trees, though the sidewalk pavement shows signs of cracking and the curb ramp area is poorly integrated with a large storm drain.

hazards.name: Uneven curb ramp and storm drain
hazards.description: The curb ramp at the foreground corner is uneven and terminates directly into a large storm drain grate, creating a trip hazard and potential wheel trap for mobility devices.
hazards.location_in_image: Bottom center foreground at the edge of the sidewalk

hazards.name: Sidewalk pavement degradation
hazards.description: Significant cracking and uneven slabs in the concrete sidewalk could cause tripping.
hazards.location_in_image: Foreground and middle ground sidewalk area

hazards.name: Visual obstruction from parked cars
hazards.description: Parked vehicles are located very close to the marked crosswalk, potentially obscuring pedestrians from the view of oncoming drivers.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the roadway near the crosswalk

interventions.title: ADA Curb Ramp Reconstruction
interventions.description: Reconstruct the corner ramp to meet modern ADA standards, ensuring a smooth transition and relocating or covering the storm drain to prevent it from being a hazard in the path of travel.

interventions.title: Intersection Daylighting
interventions.description: Remove the parking spaces closest to the crosswalk (using paint or bollards) to improve sightlines between pedestrians and drivers.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Repair
interventions.description: Patch or replace cracked concrete slabs to provide a level walking surface.
